mentions.name: Epoptes
mentions.description: Open-source tool for running coding agents (Claude, Codex, Pi, Antigravity) autonomously for long periods while the user can monitor and steer their work. It has been used for game development, research, and building other tools, with some runs lasting over 20 hours.
mentions.problem: The author struggled to find time for game development as a hobby and wanted to give agents a goal, let them work for hours, and come back to something they can try and give feedback on.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on Epoptes, an open-source tool that lets me run coding agents (Claude, Codex, Pi, Antigravity) autonomously for long periods while still being able to monitor and steer their work.
mentions.author: ramigb
